title: Story premise EDU053: The Checklist Remembers the Quiet Step
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (work/process). Hook: Which small step disappears when the big work feels done? Takeaway/theme: A checklist can make a repeatable, easily forgotten step visible at the right moment.
description: A recurring export must include subtitles, but the dramatic animation work distracts the operator from the final accessibility check. A short checklist puts the overlooked step at the point of export.
